headline: 10 deaths in 24 hours: Dengue marks deadliest day of the year in Bangladesh
summary: The death toll has risen to 281 as 1,996 new patients were hospitalised in a single day, according to the DGHS.
details: At least 10 dengue patients died in the last 24 hours, marking the highest single-day death toll recorded this year, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

The fatalities were spread across the country, with three deaths in Khulna division, two each in Barishal and Dhaka North City Corporation, and one each in Dhaka division, Dhaka South City Corporation, and Rajshahi division.
With these latest figures, the total number of dengue deaths this year has risen to 281, while the total number of cases has reached 90,356.
Currently, 5,776 dengue patients are undergoing treatment in hospitals across Bangladesh.
The surge in cases and deaths highlights the ongoing struggle to control the mosquito-borne illness during the peak season.

headline_marked: [[Rajshahi Medical University VC]] allegedly forced to resign by Jubo Dal activists
headline: Rajshahi Medical University VC allegedly forced to resign by Jubo Dal activists
summary: A group, identifying as Jubo Dal activists, stormed the VC's office, verbally and physically harassed officials, and forced them to sign pre-written resignation letters.
details: Rajshahi Medical University Vice-Chancellor Prof Md Jawadul Haque and another official were allegedly forced to sign resignation letters after a group stormed the VC's office on Tuesday.
The group, operating under the banner “Apamor Chhatra-Janata” and identifying as Jatiotabadi Jubo Dal activists, entered the campus around 11 am.
Witnesses stated the group verbally and physically harassed the officials, accusing them of being "Awami League collaborators" and awarding university work to Dhaka-based contractors.
The activists allegedly removed computer CPUs and CCTV recording equipment from the VC's room, cut electricity and internet connections, and locked the university's main gate.
Nazmul Hossain, the VC’s personal secretary, alleged he was beaten when he refused to sign his resignation letter after the VC was forced to sign his.
Rajshahi city Jubo Dal President Shariful Islam Jony denied any party involvement, stating those seen in videos were not affiliated with Jubo Dal.
Police were alerted but found no one on campus upon arrival. The university has not yet filed a complaint, but legal action will follow if it does.
caption:
Rajshahi Medical University VC and another official allegedly forced to sign resignation letters by activists. The group also reportedly stole equipment and cut campus power.

Rajshahi Medical University Vice-Chancellor Prof Md Jawadul Haque and another official were allegedly forced to sign resignation letters after a group stormed the VC's office on Tuesday.

The group, operating under the banner “Apamor Chhatra-Janata” and identifying as Jatiotabadi Jubo Dal activists, entered the campus around 11 am.

Witnesses stated the group verbally and physically harassed the officials, accusing them of being "Awami League collaborators" and awarding university work to Dhaka-based contractors.

The activists allegedly removed computer CPUs and CCTV recording equipment from the VC's room, cut electricity and internet connections, and locked the university's main gate.

Nazmul Hossain, the VC’s personal secretary, alleged he was beaten when he refused to sign his resignation letter after the VC was forced to sign his.

Rajshahi city Jubo Dal President Shariful Islam Jony denied any party involvement, stating those seen in videos were not affiliated with Jubo Dal.

Police were alerted but found no one on campus upon arrival. The university has not yet filed a complaint, but legal action will follow if it does.

Source: Prothom Alo, bdnews24.com, Jamuna TV
